[SERVICE]
  daemon off
  flush 5
  log_level warn
  parsers_file /fluent-bit/etc/parsers.conf
  http_server on
  http_listen 0.0.0.0
  http_port 2020

[INPUT]
  name syslog
  parser syslog-rfc3164
  tag syslog.*
  mode tcp
  listen 0.0.0.0
  port 5140

[INPUT]
  name syslog
  parser syslog-rfc3164
  tag syslog.*
  mode udp
  listen 0.0.0.0
  port 5140

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match syslog*
  rename message log

[OUTPUT]
  name http
  match syslog*
  host victoria-logs.observability.svc.cluster.local
  port 9428
  uri /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=host,ident&_msg_field=log&_time_field=date
  format json_lines
  json_date_format iso8601
  compress gzip
  log_response_payload false

set -euo pipefail

if [ ! -s /models/gemma4-E4B/gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M.gguf ] || [ ! -s /models/gemma4-E4B/mmproj-F16.gguf ]; then
  pip install --no-cache-dir "huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]"
  mkdir -p /models/gemma4-E4B
  rm -rf /models/gemma4-E4B/.cache/huggingface/download/gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M.gguf.lock
  hf download \
    unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF \
    gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M.gguf \
    mmproj-F16.gguf \
    --local-dir /models/gemma4-E4B

  echo "Gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M download complete"
else
  echo "Gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4_K_M already downloaded, skipping"
fi
app lidarr_log radarr_log sonarr_log prowlarr_log postgres template0 template1
